newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI begins process of selling Seat.
newsitem.headline: IRI begins process of selling Seat.

text.p: Italian state industrial holding company IRI has instituted proceedings to sell Seat, the yellow pages publishing division of state telecoms group Stet, a member of the IRI board said on Thursday.
Board member Piero Gnudi told reporters after a board meeting that the spinoff was expected to take three to four months to complete.
"We have begun the process of selling Seat. It will take three or four months to cede it completely," Gnudi said.

Another member of the board, Enrico Zanelli, said the meeting had approved plans to separate Seat from Stet as soon as possible in line with government guidelines. He said IRI was also assessing the favourability of terms of the sale.
The government last month ordered IRI to evaluate the spinoff of Seat before the sale of Stet in February or March 1997.
It also said IRI should consider the possibility of selling off Stet units cable-layer Sirti and switchgear maker Italtel
